title: LLM Attention Architecture Evolution: MHA vs. GQA-8 vs. MLA (Matrix Absorption & FlashMLA) vs. Hybrid Linear Attention

workload_assumptions.cluster_node: 8x NVIDIA H200 SXM (1,128 GB Total HBM3e)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Legacy Multi-Head Attention (MHA, n_kv=64, 1,310.7 KB/tok @ FP8 — Massive KV Footprint)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 32K session takes 40.0 GB KV Cache! Caps 8x H200 concurrency at 9 sessions

tiers.name: Tier 2: Grouped-Query Attention (GQA-8, n_kv=8, 163.8 KB/tok @ FP8 — 8x KV Reduction vs. MHA)
tiers.verdict: Standard Dense LLM workhorse (5.0 GB KV per 32K session), but Decode AI=16 FLOPs/B under-utilizes TensorCores

tiers.name: Tier 3: Naive MLA Decode Without Matrix Absorption (Materializes Uncompressed 128-Head K/V in HBM)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Decompressing c_KV into 128 heads during Decode blows up intermediate HBM bandwidth

tiers.name: Tier 4: MLA with Weight Matrix Absorption (`FlashMLA`, 35.1 KB/tok) / 7:1 Hybrid Linear-Full Attention
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 35.1 KB/tok KV (-37.3x vs. MHA, -4.67x vs. GQA), 236 32K sessions/node & $0.28/1M (-92.7%)
